discrepancies_and_resolutions.resolution: Re-examined primary PDF scan Page 94 Table VII Row 8. Replication values are R1=10.0, R2=15.0, R3=15.0, R4=10.0; reported Treatment Mean is exactly 12.50%. Operator A suffered a single-digit transcription slip. Value resolved to 12.5.

Physical inspection of scanned photocopy reveals heavy toner smear over trap catch cell. Could be either 2.0 or 3.0. In accordance with Section 3 of transcription protocol, ambiguous values are flagged and mapped to null (None) in normalized schema. Zero imputation strictly prohibited.

Both operators agreed row is absent/blank. Methodology notes confirm severe waterlogging in plot 4 due to 142mm rainfall week, preventing entry. Mapped to null (None). No artificial interpolation permitted.
